pairs: Venit autem David in Nobe ad Achimelech sacerdotem:
And Ahimelech was astonished that David had arrived.
and no one is with you?”
Et ait David ad Achimelech sacerdotem:
And David said to the priest Ahimelech:
“The king has instructed to me a word,
Nemo sciat rem propter quam missus es a me,
‘Let no one know the matter about which you have been sent by me,
and what type of instructions I have given to you.
nam et pueris condixi in illum et illum locum.
For I have also summoned servants to one and another place.’
Nunc ergo si quid habes ad manum,
Now therefore, if you have anything at hand,
or whatever you may find, give it to me.”
And the priest, responding to David,
Non habeo laicos panes ad manum,
“I have no common bread at hand,
And David responded to the priest,
we have abstained since yesterday and the day before,
and so the vessels of the young men have been holy.
et ipsa hodie sanctificabitur in vasis.
it will also be sanctified today as concerns the vessels.”
Dedit ergo ei sacerdos sanctificatum panem:
Therefore, the priest gave to him sanctified bread.
For there was no bread there,
but only the bread of the Presence,
qui sublati fuerant a facie Domini,
which had been taken away from before the face of the Lord,
so that fresh loaves might be set up.
Erat autem ibi vir quidam de servis Saul in die illa,
Now a certain man among the servants of Saul was there on that day,
inside the tabernacle of the Lord.
And his name was Doeg, an Edomite,
the most powerful among the shepherds of Saul.
Si habes hic ad manum hastam aut gladium?
“Do you have, here at hand, a spear or a sword?
quia gladium meum et arma mea non tuli mecum:
For I did not take my own sword, or my own weapons with me.
For the word of the king was urgent.”
here is the sword of Goliath, the Philistine,
whom you struck down in the Valley of Terebinth.
It is wrapped up in a cloak behind the ephod.
If you wish to take this,
neque enim hic est alius absque eo.
For there is nothing else here except this.”
et fugit in die illa a facie Saul:
and he fled on that day from the face of Saul.
et venit ad Achis regem Geth.
And he went to Achish, the king of Gath.
Dixeruntque servi Achis ad eum cum vidissent David:
And the servants of Achish, when they had seen David, said to him:
Numquid non iste est David rex terræ?
“Is this not David, the king of the land?
Were they not singing about him, while dancing,
saying, ‘Saul has struck down a thousand,
Posuit autem David sermones istos in corde suo,
Then David took these words to his heart,
et extimuit valde a facie Achis regis Geth.
and he became exceedingly afraid before the face of Achish, the king of Gath.
Et immutavit os suum coram eis,
And he altered his mouth before them,
and he slipped down between their hands.
And he stumbled against the doors of the gate.
And his spit flowed down his beard.
Et ait Achis ad servos suos:
And Achish said to his servants:
“You saw that the man is insane.
Why did you bring him to me?
Or do we have need of those who are mad,
so that you would bring in this one,
to behave madly in my presence?
How did this man get into my house?”
